---
title: "check-unexplained-choices.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, warn-only check that flags an analysis choice in code
that the prose around it never explains.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-11-03,
[ai-config#4905](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/ai-config/issues/4905))
is that every arbitrary analysis choice, such as binning a variable,
is explained in detail in the prose:
what was chosen, what the alternatives were, and why this one.

The check reads code lines in a fenced chunk for these choices:
`cut()`, `cut_number()`, `cut_interval()`, `cut_width()`, `pd.cut()`, `pd.qcut()`,
`np.histogram()`, `breaks =`, `bins =`, `binwidth =`, `nbins =`,
`set.seed()`, `random_state =`, `np.random.seed()`,
a numeric `bw =`, `bandwidth =`, `span =`, `threshold =` or `cutoff =`,
`train_test_split()`, `initial_split()`, `test_size =` and `prop =`.

A choice is explained when the prose of its unit holds a reason word
such as "because", "chose", "choice", "compromise", "rather than",
"alternative" or "arbitrary".
The unit is the outermost div around the chunk (a figure, example or exercise),
or, outside any div, the text from the previous heading to the next one.

The check does not read:

- a unit whose prose holds a reason word, outside code fences, display math and HTML comments;
- a code line that starts with `#`, such as a comment or a `#|` chunk option;
- a line carrying `<!-- check-unexplained-choices: allow -->`.

The pattern list is noisy by design,
since a seed in a plain simulation is fine,
which is why `fail` defaults to `false`.
Whether an explanation is good is a judgment the author makes.

## Scope

Only an added line is reported.
The whole file is parsed, since the explaining prose may sit far from the changed line.
With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to scan every tracked file on purpose,
which measures how many existing choices go unexplained.

## Usage

Copy
[`examples/check-unexplained-choices.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-unexplained-choices.yml)
to `.github/workflows/` in your repository.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check |
| `paths-ignore` | empty | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns to skip |
| `fail` | `false` | Fail the workflow on a finding instead of warning |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Scan every choice, not only a pull request's additions |
| `runs-on` | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label; self-hosted only for a private repository |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version to set up |

## Permissions

The job needs `contents: read` only.

## Example

```yaml
name: Check for unexplained analysis choices

on:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-unexplained-choices.yml@v3
    with:
      paths-ignore: 'chapters/outtakes/**'
```
